title: Durable first-service origin reconciliation
north_star: First-service bootstrap must be absorbed by the release architecture instead of becoming repeated human troubleshooting.
scope: Add ORIGIN_RECONCILED as the durable transition between REVISION_CREATED and STARTUP_VERIFIED.
Prepare real-origin revision manifests without cloud mutation.
Require exact plan-bound approval before any Cloud Run replacement.
non_goals: No startup or smoke gate recording during installation.
required_post_install_order: Create an ORIGIN_RECONCILED plan from the startup-origin inspection evidence.
Perform the one approved Cloud Run service replacement.
